svg.title: Reload while serving queries
svg.desc: The hidden primary sends NOTIFY. xfrd retrieves and stores the transfer. Main forks a reload process, which applies changes and runs verification. After acceptance it forks new query workers; old processes retire. Existing workers serve the old data while the update is prepared. The animation illustrates the sequence described in the accompanying text.

g.text: Query workers use the current database while xfrd manages transfers.
The query worker forwards the notification directly to xfrd.
xfrd obtains the transfer and writes the received changes to disk.
The current query workers continue serving the existing data.
The reload process incorporates transferred data into the candidate database.
Unchanged memory pages can remain shared through copy-on-write.
The external verifier accepts the update with exit status 0.
The accepted database is inherited by the new workers.
After a successful reload, the old workers and main process exit.
The new main and query workers now use the updated database.
